expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Sleeping on Nusa Penida changes the trip. You get Kelingking in the soft morning light with nobody else on the path.
expert.tip: Pack an overnight bag for the island so the big cases stay in Kuta. The last boat back leaves in the early afternoon, which is why Ubud gets a gentle arrival day.

summary: Seven days with return flights, two nights on the Kuta coast, a night on Nusa Penida itself for the west coast viewpoints and snorkelling, then three nights in a five star valley resort near Ubud with a spa hour, quad bikes and Kintamani.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private transfers and the Nusa Penida speedboat; water sports with Uluwatu and the Kecak dance; private Nusa Penida west coast tour with snorkelling; Balinese massage for two; tandem ATV ride; Kintamani highlands tour.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
